description: Which /sessions/*.md filenames are frozen sessions. Agent transcripts (agent-<name>-<timestamp>.md, written by packages/webapp/src/scoops/agent-session-archive.ts) share the directory but are never sessions. Hand-maintained; held against the webapp by packages/webapp/tests/transcript/frozen-session-filenames-corpus.test.ts (isAgentSessionArchiveFilename, frozenSessionRows, rebuildSessionsIndexFromArchives) and against the iOS follower by FrozenSessionsTests.swift (FrozenSessionIndex.parse, FrozenSessionIndex.rebuild).
